d: From India-Poland ties to highway safety reforms, Firstpost examines Prime Minister Donald Tusk’s India visit, growing cooperation in defence, nuclear energy and trade, and the goal of doubling bilateral trade by 2030. Hem Saroya also explains India’s tougher penalties for highway contractors, including fines of up to ₹50 lakh per fatality for repeated accidents linked to the same construction defect, and whether stricter accountability can make Indian roads safer. Hem Kaur Saroya tell you more.
